# Skin author contract

<!-- Generated by packages/ui-kit-system/scripts/gen-tokens.ts. Run `pnpm --filter @conciv/ui-kit-system gen:tokens` after editing a skin. -->

A skin is a typed object in `packages/ui-kit-system/src/skin-<name>.ts`. It sets **only** the 37 anchors below; every other `--chat-*` custom property is internal, derived once from these anchors in the base sheet, and not writable by a skin. Omitting an anchor, or either half of a `{light, dark}` pair, is a compile error.

A host page selects a skin by declaring the `--conciv-skin` custom property on `html` or `body`:

```css
html {
  --conciv-skin: terminal;
}
```

An unknown or absent value falls back to `conciv` with one console warning. The detector re-reads the property on the same signals as colour-scheme detection: `class`, `style` and `data-theme` mutations on `html` and `body`. A stylesheet-only change that flips none of those does not live-update.

The widget stamps the resolved skin as a class on every render root it owns, so portalled menus, the effects overlay and popped-out windows all follow.

## Shipped skins

| name | label | applied as | look |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `conciv` | Conciv | default, no class | The default look: cool neutral panels, a blue accent on light and a warm clay accent on dark. |
| `terminal` | Terminal | `.chat-skin-terminal` | A monospace-forward look: warm paper on light, near-black on dark, phosphor-green accent, squared corners and flat elevation. |

## Anchors

### surfaces

| anchor | shape | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--chat-panel` | `{light, dark}` | Opaque panel body. The widget reads as this colour. |
| `--chat-glass` | `{light, dark}` | Translucent floating surface (menus, popovers, dialogs). |
| `--chat-sunken` | `{light, dark}` | Recessed surface for code blocks and read-only fields. |
| `--chat-ground` | `{light, dark}` | Deepest ground behind the panel body. |
| `--chat-backdrop` | `{light, dark}` | Modal scrim. Dark in both schemes by convention. |

| anchor | shape | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--chat-text` | `{light, dark}` | Primary body ink. |
| `--chat-text-hi` | `{light, dark}` | Emphasis ink for headings and strong text. |
| `--chat-text-2` | `{light, dark}` | Secondary ink for labels and muted prose. |
| `--chat-text-3` | `{light, dark}` | Faint ink for metadata and timestamps. |

| anchor | shape | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--chat-fill` | `{light, dark}` | Neutral fill layered over the panel. |
| `--chat-fill-soft` | `{light, dark}` | Lightest neutral fill. |
| `--chat-fill-strong` | `{light, dark}` | Strongest neutral fill, used for hover and active. |
| `--chat-line` | `{light, dark}` | Default hairline. |
| `--chat-line-soft` | `{light, dark}` | Quietest hairline, for internal dividers. |
| `--chat-line-2` | `{light, dark}` | Emphasised hairline, for focused and outer edges. |

| anchor | shape | meaning |

| `--chat-accent` | `{light, dark}` | Brand accent. Drives links, focus rings and primary fills. |
| `--chat-on-accent` | `{light, dark}` | Ink placed on an accent fill. |

| anchor | shape | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--chat-danger` | `{light, dark}` | Error ink and error borders. |
| `--chat-success` | `{light, dark}` | Success ink and success borders. |
| `--chat-warn` | `{light, dark}` | Warning ink and warning borders. |
| `--chat-dim` | `{light, dark}` | Base colour of the pending and thinking shimmer. |

| anchor | shape | meaning |

| anchor | shape | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--chat-space` | single value | Spacing base unit of the conversation surfaces (thread and composer). Stay within roughly 8% of 0.25rem; text sizes ride the font scale and do not shrink with it. |

## Rules

- Colour and shadow anchors are `{light, dark}` pairs and are emitted as one `light-dark()` declaration each, so a skin is complete for both schemes by construction.
- The skin class always lands on the same element as the colour-scheme class. That co-location is load-bearing: the production build lowers `light-dark()` into helper custom properties that resolve at the declaring element.
- Hand-tuned semantics (the agent hue, permission gold, rail and status-bar surfaces, diff backgrounds, the Shiki palette) stay internal and identical across skins. Skins retint the anchors; semantics stay consistent.
- `--chat-space` scales the spacing base of the conversation surfaces only (thread and composer). Frame geometry, fixed placements and arbitrary-value CSS do not follow it. Stay within roughly 8% of `0.25rem`.
- Every skin's colour pairs are checked for WCAG contrast in CI. An inaccessible skin fails the build.
